title: tx_queue_stats_get claims thread-safety but lacks lock
description:
Header (line 207-208) documents: 'Thread-safe atomic copy under lock'. Implementation (lines 416-430) does NOT acquire queue->lock before copying stats. The implementation comment acknowledges this: 'This read is not atomic with respect to concurrent writes.' Either fix the implementation to take the lock, or correct the header documentation.

File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/tx_queue.c
Line: 416
close_reason: Fixed: tx_queue_stats_get() (tx_queue.c lines 434-444) now acquires queue->lock via lock_queue() before '*stats = queue->stats' and unlocks after. Implementation comment acknowledging non-atomicity removed; header doc now accurate. Fix present in current working tree, UNCOMMITTED — must be included in next commit. Verified empirically: TSAN-instrumented host build runs test_concurrent_thread_safety (reader thread: 5000x stats_get/count/empty vs concurrent push/pop) with zero race reports; full suite 22/22 pass. project-LICHEN-worker6-laiu closed as same-root-cause duplicate.
